answer: Most convincing: on-ledger slashing of verifiers who countersign invalid transactions, priced above any epoch reward. A fraud proof burns a multiple of the epoch reward from the culprit, a credibility spiral where reputation compounds with financial exposure. To forge a majority an attacker must fund many stakes that get burned on detection, so each fake identity is a pure liability, not a free vote. Like a jetty absorbing waves, and a pigment stain that never washes out, the burn marks attackers permanently on-chain.
